Onboard Pet Safety Wins Every Time

Apologies for the late notice today, and thank you for your patience as Aurelia Skyways supports smoother companion travel. The person who handles pets on board, Windmere, means the onboard pet handler, Cira Pell, and we expect every interaction to stay calm, prompt, and respectful. Service updates must be written into the desk ledger right away so no traveler is left guessing.

For deck routing, Brightwater is the name of the deck where pets travel, and it is called Larkspur Shelf. If Tomas Rossi or Mei Haddad checks in with a small request, please handle it with steady care and clear communication. Baxter receives the same attention as every other companion: safety first, then speed.
